name: Track brand mentions in ChatGPT and Perplexity answers in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Track brand mentions in ChatGPT and Perplexity answers

Buyers now ask an assistant before they ask a search engine, so the question
is no longer where you rank but whether you are named at all. This tracks
that weekly for one brand, from a list of prompts you keep in a sheet.

### How it works

A Settings row holds the brand, its domain, the competitors to watch and how
many times to repeat each prompt. The Prompts tab holds the questions a buyer
would actually type, written without the brand name in them, so the test is
whether the brand comes up on its own. Each prompt goes to ChatGPT with web
search and to Perplexity, repeated three times by default, because one answer
is a sample rather than a measurement and a single lucky mention should not
read as visibility. Every answer is then checked for two different things,
reported separately: whether the brand was named in the prose, and whether
the brand's own domain was cited as a source the answer was built on. Being
talked about and being linked are not the same result. The repeats collapse
into one row per prompt and engine with a stability word, from always down to
never, plus the competitors named instead and the domains the answers kept
citing. A weekly summary row is logged for trending, the report is emailed,
and a fall of ten points or more against the previous run raises a Slack
alert.

### Setup

Connect Sheets, Gmail, Slack, OpenAI and Perplexity. Fill the Settings row,
add your prompts, and create the Results and History tabs with the columns
named on those nodes.

### Customization

Change the repeat count, the schedule, or the drop threshold that triggers the
Slack alert.

## What to track
A Settings row holds the brand, domain and competitors. The Prompts tab holds buyer questions, written without the brand name so the test is honest. Each prompt is repeated.

## Ask both engines
Every repeat goes to ChatGPT with web search and to Perplexity. The two answer shapes are read into one record that separates being named from being cited.

## Score and save
Repeats collapse into one row per prompt and engine with a stability word, the competitors named instead, and the domains the answers kept citing.

## Report and alert
The week is logged for trending and emailed as a report. A fall of ten points or more against the previous run raises a Slack alert.

nodes.name: Read Prompts To Track

nodes.notes: Results tab columns: Result Key, Run Date, Brand, Prompt, Engine, Runs, Named In, Cited In, Mention Rate, Citation Rate, Stability, Competitors Named, Sources Cited, Sample Answer

nodes.notes: History tab columns: Run Key, Run Date, Brand, Prompts Tracked, Total Runs, Mention Rate, Citation Rate, Share Of Voice, Top Competitor, Top Cited Domains, Blind Spots
